chunks: Muḥammad ibn Ḥumrān narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh, from his father, peace be upon them both, who said:

I was with ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, peace be upon them both, in the Sanctuary, and he saw me harming the swallows. So he said: O my son, do not kill them and do not harm them, for they do not harm anything.

key_terms.الْحَرَمِ: the Sacred Sanctuary, the inviolable holy precinct
key_terms.الْخَطَّاطِيفَ: swallows, the birds mentioned in the narration
key_terms.يَا بُنَيَّ: O my son, an affectionate form of address

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about harming or killing swallows in the Sacred Sanctuary?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام forbade harming or killing swallows in the Sacred Sanctuary. It conveys both a legal implication regarding conduct in the Ḥaram and an ethical teaching of refraining from harming harmless creatures.
